What is a self-transfer package?A self-transfer package includes several flights combined into one itinerary. After booking, this package will be separated into several bookings and the tickets will be issued individually. Each ticket has different policies.
1. Change and cancellation policies may vary by ticket. Each ticket must be changed or canceled separately in accordance with its individual airline policies.
2. Baggage allowances may also vary by ticket. For more details, please check the related policies.
3. Pay special attention to the transfer process. When transferring in [Skopje], you may need to complete the entry/exit procedures, collect your baggage, and check in again. Please ensure you have the necessary travel documents/transit visas for the countries/regions where you will transfer.
